def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # For A-strand append (even index), use strand-sum = (last_A + last_B) mod 8
    # last_A is the last even-indexed element (state[0] for len 2)
    # last_B is the last odd-indexed element (state[1] for len 2)
    last_a = state[0]
    last_b = state[1]
    new_element = (last_a + last_b) % 8
    return state + [new_element]
